source.title: Arbortenders of the Luminous Bloom — LIVE Wowhead item-side Looter Disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (unidentified player submissions)

notes: Unindexed LIVE item-side reference snapshot checked 2026-11-19, distinct from prior indexed 250021/250022/250023/250024/250026/250027. Source shows 32 pooled table disenchants and two visually identical Dawn Crystal result rows; row 1 reports 15 material occurrences. Same-name rows can represent different material ranks; original linked output IDs/ranks not exposed. Looter source is mutable and pooled (potentially correlated with other items); not a new independent complete player-cast study, and PTR does NOT establish live eligibility. Do not treat source row count as an audited per-character cast denominator, sum same-name rows, infer any zero disenchant operation, observed yield range, output quantity or confidence. At-cast itemLink/bonus/item level, gear quality, build, profession skill and spec, material rank, stack histogram, conditional weekly byproducts, and original timestamps are unavailable. Selected tooltip Mythic ilvl289/base44 is NOT at-cast ilvl. Reference-only; no estimator weight or conversion to hit probability.
